title: Winston Logging System
goal: Implement production-grade structured logging using Winston with log levels, daily rotation, and separate error logs for debugging and monitoring.

sub_tasks.title: Create Winston Logger Configuration
sub_tasks.output: Configured Winston with JSON format, timestamps, error stack traces, and service metadata

sub_tasks.title: Configure Daily Rotating File Transport
sub_tasks.output: Added winston-daily-rotate-file for error logs (30 days retention, 20MB max) and combined logs (14 days, 50MB max)

sub_tasks.title: Add Console Transport for Development
sub_tasks.output: Colorized console logging in development mode with human-readable format

sub_tasks.title: Set Dynamic Log Levels
sub_tasks.output: Log level configurable via LOG_LEVEL env var, defaults to 'info' in production, 'debug' in development

acceptance_criteria: Winston logger properly configured with JSON format
Separate rotating logs for errors (error-%DATE%.log, 30 day retention)
Combined logs for all levels (combined-%DATE%.log, 14 day retention)
Console logging in development with colorized output
Log level configurable via environment variable
Timestamp included in all log entries
Service metadata attached to all logs
result_summary: Production-grade logging system implemented with Winston. Daily rotating file transports ensure logs don't fill disk space (30 days for errors, 14 days for combined). Structured JSON logging in production enables log aggregation tools. Colorized console output in development for better DX. Configurable log levels support different environments.
